title: Render tree vs module dependency tree

slides.say: Your app has a second tree. Not who renders whom, but who imports whom.

slides.text: Each node is a module (a file). Each branch is an import statement.
slides.say: In the module dependency tree, every node is a module, and every branch is an import statement.
Two differences from the render tree. Plain data files like quotes show up too. And Copyright hangs under App here, because App imports it, even though Gallery renders it as a child.

slides.text: Bundlers use this tree to decide what code to ship. Big tree → big bundle → slower first paint.
slides.say: Bundlers use this tree to decide which code to ship. A large bundle is slow to download and run, so this tree helps you debug bundle size.
